extraction.notes: Reconciliation taken from TABLE 2 (page seq 9, printed 7); an identical table appears at seq 34 (printed 19). The 2024 column was used. AVB reports no AFFO metric, so affo fields are null. Starting net income attributable to common stockholders ($173,449) differs from the Attachment 11 Table 1 net income ($173,557), which is a different starting point; the table 2 figure was used. Distributions to noncontrolling interests is printed as an em dash for 2024 and recorded as 0. Diluted share count printed in full (142,222,755) and converted to thousands. Check: 387,801/142,222.755 = $2.73 and 383,758/142,222.755 = $2.70, matching reported per-share figures. Adjustments sum correctly to both subtotals. Some items (SIP loan reserve, advocacy contributions, other real estate activity, condo carry cost, income tax) were classified as 'other' because no listed category fits.
